newsitem.title: UK: Pru eyes strategy talks with portfolio -FT.
newsitem.headline: Pru eyes strategy talks with portfolio -FT.

text.p: UK life and pensions giant Prudential Corporation said it has set up a mechanism to discuss advance strategy talks with companies already in its investment portfolios, the Financial Times reported.
Derek Higgs, head of the Pru's fund management arm Prudential Portfolio Managers, told the FT that his fund managers would not have to stop trading shares of companies who availed of the mechanism.
Higgs said this is because of so-called "chinese walls", where both he and the corporate finance team is physically separate from the dealing and fund management area.
Higgs also told the FT be believed companies should secure shareholder approval for political donations.
